crew.overview: Sara is a teen girl who is looking forward to her 18th birthday to move away from her controlling father Don. But before she could even blow out the candles, Don imprisons her in the basement of their home.
crew.title: Girl in the Basement

details.biography: Sebastian Dungan was born on 12 March 1972 in Los Angeles, California, USA. He is a producer and actor, known for Transamerica (2005), Better Off Dead (1985) and Girl in the Basement (2021). He has been married to Lavi Sholem Soloway since 6 October 2009.
details.name: Sebastian Dungan
